narr: Monsoon moisture over northern Arizona and slow steering winds allowed thunderstorms to produce localized heavy rain and flash flooding.
ev: Flooding of several roads in the Cornville area, including Cornville Road near Cactus Road was seen on a social media video. Another video showed property and street flooding east of Page Springs Road and north of Cornville Road. There was also flooding along Harmony, Oak Run Lane, and Page Springs Road. Flooding of multiple homes along Alvey and Brooks Lanes. The fire department personnel reported at least 6 homes flooded in Cornville.
